# Mission Control **A cross-project dashboard plugin and auxiliary-pane web UI sidecar for Antigravity.** Monitor every workspace, triage approvals, live agent questions, and unseen completed threads, inspect Swarm boards and Git telemetry, and steer threads without leaving your current context. [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Node.js-20%2B-339933.svg?logo=node.js&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org/) [![Zero Dependencies](https://img.shields.io/badge/dependencies-zero-10b981.svg)](#architecture) [![Antigravity Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/Antigravity-Aux%20Pane%20Sidecar-6366f1.svg)](#quick-start) [Features](#features) · [Quick Start](#quick-start) · [Standalone Preview](#standalone-preview) · [Architecture](#architecture) · [HTTP API](#sidecar-http-api) · [Development](#development--testing) · [License](#license)

--- ## Features - **Cross-Project "Needs Attention" Triage Strip** Surfaces high-priority states across all Antigravity workspaces in one horizontal triage bar: - **Approval** (`Approve` / `Diff`) — pending command or file approvals blocking execution. - **Error / Quota** — surfaced run failures and rate/quota stops. - **Question** (`Reply` / `Open`) — active pending `ask_question` tool calls waiting on user input (without false positives on normal finished answers). - **Stuck** — stalled active runs flagged for attention. - **Done (Unseen)** (`Open` / `Dismiss`) — emerald-badged cards that bubble newly finished threads to the top until you open or dismiss them. Seen timestamps persist to `seen_threads.json` under `ANTIGRAVITY_EXECUTABLE_DATA_DIR`, and the currently open `conversationId` is auto-marked seen. - **Multi-Project 2×2 Workspace Matrix** Collapses navigation clutter into a compact icon rail and displays each project in a telemetry-rich card: - Active Git branch, staged/unstaged working-tree line diffs (`+added -removed`), and linked `git worktree` counts. - Optional GitHub CLI (`gh`) PR & CI check status. - Live thread status counts, active **Swarm** roster badges, and scheduled **Cron** automations (`HH:MM` + next-run countdown). - **Live Right-Hand Thread Peek & Quick-Reply Inspector** Click any thread card or triage item to open the inspector pane alongside the project grid: - Switch across **Activity** (including pending approval and `ask_question` cards even on Swarm threads), **Swarm** (member states & board messages), **Files**, and **Diff** tabs. - Send follow-up instructions or approve/reject actions directly from the docked quick-reply composer (dispatched via `agentapi`). - **Dedicated Views, Fast Filtering & Command Palette** - Switch between **Overview**, **Board** (4-column Kanban), **Timeline** (chronological feed), and **Graph** (interactive SVG workspace/thread/swarm topology). - Filter instantly by `All`, `Needs Attention`, or `Running`, search across workspaces and threads, jump anywhere with `Ctrl+K` / `Cmd+K`, toggle Live/Demo datasets, or collapse cleanly into a responsive drawer in narrow aux panes. - **Zero Runtime Dependencies & Aux-Pane Native** Pure Node.js ESM backend with zero third-party `npm` dependencies, paired with a self-contained classic IIFE frontend bundle (`public/app.js` compiled via `build_client.mjs`) so Antigravity's authenticated `sidecar_sdk` iframe loads reliably without ES-module CORS preflights and inherits host dark/light CSS variables automatically. --- ## Quick Start ### 1. Install the Plugin Clone this repository and run the idempotent installer to link it into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/mission-control`: ```bash git clone https://github.com/jasona/mission-control.git cd mission-control ./install.sh ``` Installer options: ```bash ./install.sh # Symlink into ~/.gemini/config/plugins/mission-control (default) ./install.sh --copy # Copy plugin files instead of symlinking ./install.sh --force # Back up an existing directory or replace a mismatched symlink ./install.sh --uninstall # Remove ~/.gemini/config/plugins/mission-control ``` > [!NOTE] > Node.js 20+ must be available in your `PATH`. Set `GEMINI_PLUGINS_DIR` to override the default `~/.gemini/config/plugins` install location. ### 2. Enable & Open in Antigravity 1. Open **Customizations → Plugins → Mission Control** (`customization://mission-control`) and ensure **Mission Control** is enabled. 2. Open the auxiliary pane view via `[Open Mission Control](sidecar://mission-control/mission_control/)`, or ask an Antigravity agent to open Mission Control. --- ## Standalone Preview You can preview Mission Control in any browser outside Antigravity using its built-in standalone HTTP server: ```bash # Demo mode with interactive sample workspaces, swarms, crons, and triage items node sidecars/mission_control/main.mjs --standalone --demo --port 4321 ``` Then open **http://127.0.0.1:4321/** (add `?demo=1` if you started without `--demo`). To inspect your real local Antigravity workspaces, transcripts, swarms, Git repos, and scheduled cron jobs instead of sample data, omit `--demo`: ```bash node sidecars/mission_control/main.mjs --standalone --port 4321 ``` Supported CLI flags and environment variables: | Option | Env Fallback | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | `--standalone` | `SIDECAR_STANDALONE=1` | `false` | Forces loopback `node:http` server instead of `sidecar_sdk`. | | `--demo` | `SIDECAR_DEMO=1` | `false` | Serves the stateful demo dataset by default. | | `--port ` | `PORT` | `4321` | Port to bind on `127.0.0.1`. | --- ## Architecture For the original design goals and UI breakdown, see [docs/mission_control_plugin.md](docs/mission_control_plugin.md). ```text mission-control/ ├── LICENSE # MIT License ├── .gitignore ├── plugin.json # Antigravity plugin manifest ├── install.sh # Idempotent symlink/copy/uninstall installer ├── README.md ├── assets/ │ └── logo.svg # High-contrast 128x128 plugin icon ├── docs/ │ ├── mission_control_plugin.md # Design spec │ └── mission_control_plugin.png # Hero UI creative ├── rules/ │ └── AGENTS.md # Always-on rule for Mission Control entry points ├── skills/ │ └── mission-control/ │ └── SKILL.md # Skill guiding agents on opening & using the panel └── sidecars/ └── mission_control/ ├── package.json # Zero-dependency Node ESM manifest ├── sidecar.json # Aux-pane sidecar manifest ├── main.mjs # SidecarApp + standalone HTTP server & preload stub ├── build_client.mjs # Zero-dep ESM -> classic IIFE frontend bundler ├── lib/ │ ├── discovery.mjs # Projects, brains, plugins & sidecars discovery │ ├── transcript.mjs # transcript.jsonl parser, pending prompt & cache │ ├── swarm.mjs # Swarm members, board messages & worker dedupe │ ├── git.mjs # Async git branch, diff, worktree & optional gh PR telemetry │ ├── cron.mjs # Scheduled cron parser & next-run computation │ ├── seen.mjs # Persistent seen-thread tracking (seen_threads.json) │ ├── aggregator.mjs # Snapshot, triage ranking, graph & ETag builder │ ├── actions.mjs # Reply, approval & new-thread dispatch via agentapi │ └── demo.mjs # Stateful demo dataset & interactive actions ├── public/ │ ├── index.html # Aux-pane HTML shell loading classic /app.js │ ├── styles.css # Obsidian theme + host CSS token sync + drawer styles │ ├── app-main.js # Client entrypoint (polling, filters, shortcuts, palette) │ ├── app.js # Generated classic IIFE bundle (via build_client.mjs) │ ├── components/ │ │ ├── icons.js # Inline SVG icon helpers │ │ └── modal.js # New Thread, Reply, Diff & Command Palette modals │ └── views/ │ ├── overview.js # Needs Attention triage strip + 2x2 workspace grid │ ├── board.js # 4-column Kanban board view │ ├── timeline.js # Chronological activity feed │ ├── graph.js # Interactive SVG workspace/thread/swarm topology │ └── inspector.js # Right-hand Thread Peek & Quick-Reply inspector └── test/ ├── aggregator.test.mjs # Unit/integration tests for aggregation, triage & seen store └── server.test.mjs # HTTP handler & static bundle route tests ``` --- ## Sidecar HTTP API Both `SidecarApp` (authenticated Antigravity bridge) and standalone mode expose the same routes: | Method & Route | Parameters / JSON Body | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `GET /api/dashboard` | `?demo=1&etag=...&conversationId=...` | Returns full cross-project telemetry, Needs Attention items, workspaces, threads, graph, and cron schedules (or `unchanged: true` on matching `etag`). | | `GET /api/thread` | `?id=&demo=...` | Returns detailed thread activity, Swarm board/roster, changed files, and git diff. | | `POST /api/reply` | `{ threadId, message, demo }` | Sends a follow-up prompt or answer to a thread via `agentapi` (or demo store). | | `POST /api/approve` | `{ threadId, decision, demo }` | Submits an approval/rejection decision for a waiting step. | | `POST /api/threads/new` | `{ projectId, title, prompt, model, demo }` | Starts a new conversation in the target workspace. | | `POST /api/seen` | `{ threadId, seenAtMs, demo }` | Marks a thread as seen/dismissed so completed `Done` items clear from triage. | --- ## Development & Testing Mission Control requires zero `npm install` steps—only Node.js 20+ (and `bash` for `./install.sh`). After editing client modules under `sidecars/mission_control/public/` (`app-main.js`, `components/*`, or `views/*`), rebuild the classic IIFE bundle (`public/app.js`): ```bash node sidecars/mission_control/build_client.mjs ``` Run the automated test suite: ```bash node --test sidecars/mission_control/test/*.test.mjs ``` --- ## License Distributed under the [MIT License](LICENSE). Copyright (c) 2026 Jason Alexander.
